why.intro: Every eye break rests your focus on something far away; every few breaks, you stand and move. The tips come from:
src.aao: American Academy of Ophthalmology: computers and eye strain
src.albulescu: Albulescu et al. 2022, micro-breaks and well-being (PLOS ONE)
src.dunstan: Dunstan et al. 2012, breaking up sitting (Diabetes Care)
src.ccohs: Canadian Centre for Occupational Health and Safety: working while sitting

set.calls_sub: No break while an app uses your microphone or camera
welcome.title: Welcome to BrightPause
welcome.text: Every 20 minutes you get a 20-second eye break, and about once an hour a short movement break. Change anything below; it saves right away. BrightPause lives in the tray.

short.need_modifier: Hold Ctrl, Alt or Shift with the key.
